description: HDV Highway Cost Allocation Dataset is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Dave Cooke (Union of Concerned Scientists). Data supporting allocation of highway costs to light- and heavy-duty vehicles, including funding, expenditures, and VMT by loaded weight. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. Formats: PDF, Excel. Size stated: 761520. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
